verdict.rationale: Remote documents a white-label partner program for surfacing its workflows inside a partner's own UI, SDKs for custom-UI or drop-in embedded flows, partner OAuth to act on behalf of consenting companies, and an API that pushes payroll inputs and pulls payroll data. However, the documented embeddable flows are cost calculators and onboarding, not payroll itself, so white-label payroll specifically is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of embeddable white-label payroll runs or payroll UI components, payroll-specific partner API detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a partner embedding payroll.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed white-label payroll into my own product through a partner API

citations.quote: become a white-label partner and surface Remote workflows inside your own UI for your users.
push people, contracts, and payroll inputs into Remote, or pull workforce and payroll data out to your systems
helps our partners embed Remote's powerful workflows (like cost calculators or onboarding flows) into their products in a matter of hours, not weeks.
exchange them for access tokens, and act on behalf of the companies that grant you consent.
